interest: Shows 1930s counterfeiting of Parker pens and Pro-phy-lac-tic toothbrushes, and debate over diplomatic intervention.
overview: Docket (1935-37) on Japanese trademark infringement: Parker Pen's counterfeiting complaints and frustration with diplomats, and a Prophylactic Toothbrush Company patent-violation memo.

people.name: Eugene H. Dooman
people.role: Officer, Division of Far Eastern Affairs, Department of State

subfiles.about: List of Papers docket sheet indexing correspondence and memoranda on complaints by the Parker Pen Company regarding trade name and trademark infringements by Japanese manufacturers in Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Docket: Parker Pen submits evidence of Tokyo counterfeiters, criticizing diplomats, as State and Commerce weigh legal grounds to act.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Infringement of Trade Name of the Parker Pen Co.

subfiles.about: List of Papers docket sheet indexing a memorandum on Japanese manufacturers' violations of trademark and patent rights belonging to the Prophylactic Toothbrush Company.
subfiles.summary: Docket: Dooman's memo details Japanese infringement of the Prophylactic Toothbrush Company's trademark and patent rights.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Trade-mark, Trade Name of the Prophylactic Toothbrush Co. - Japan
